method: Desktop Chromium 1280x720. A user-owned normal-play save was imported through System > Save/Replay > Import Save. Units were selected by visible canvas clicks and moved by normal right-click ground commands. No game private API, runtime command, state mutation, route mock, or clock control was used.

military.paidNormalPlayEvidence: Imported owner save showed 邊境戰士 150/150 and normal military controls 攻擊移動/巡邏/橫列/主動/碎甲擊/停止.
